review_method: raw git show, SHA256, AST and manual source inspection; no target imports or execution
source_findings: No ResearchRunner, sync, storage, network, provider, process, clock, random or file APIs in inspected project import closure.
For fixed plain input values and ordered bars the function uses deterministic local arithmetic and returns an in-memory ResearchTrade.
Market entry uses first bar t >= decision_time. Limit entry requires t >= decision_time + bar_ms. SL_FIRST chooses stop when both levels touched. Fees and adverse entry/exit slippage are included.
No funding, durable ledger, idempotency, authority, checkpoint, resource enforcement or worker recovery in this function. No trade/order publication.
conditions: Use pinned checkout/package roots and trusted pinned stdlib; source review does not attest ambient import resolution.
Allow only validated built-in dictionaries/lists and plain finite scalar values; arbitrary iterators, mappings, metadata and numeric objects can execute user-defined methods.

Validate ordered unique timestamps, finite positive OHLC, coherent high/low, side-specific stop/target, positive position/bar_ms, nonnegative bounded fee/slippage, enumerated ambiguity policy and limit entry price before calling. Function itself validates only side and entry_kind.
Bound bars <10000 and episodes <=256, serial profile <=60s externally; these are declarative limits, not native CPU quotas.
Catch entry-not-filled and malformed input as explicit candidate rejection; no fabricated successful trade.
Keep metadata plain and owned: output metadata copy is shallow.
No Math transforms, core edits, runtime/export/provider/native/physical admission.
